audit.whatIsWrong: The entry invents an ability called "Corrupted Fling" and uses it three times — early "his passive regeneration plus Corrupted Fling's peel", spikes[2] "his own Corrupted Fling AoE", whys[5] "Singed's Corrupted Fling regen".
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/singed.json: P Noxious Slipstream, Q Poison Trail, W Mega Adhesive, E Fling, R Insanity Potion. There is no Corrupted Fling. Worse, the invented ability is credited with an AoE and with regeneration, neither of which exists anywhere in Singed's kit — Fling is a single-target displacement, full stop.
audit.corrected: Fling. It is single-target, it displaces, and it neither heals him nor deals area damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Mega Adhesive into Fling root is never mentioned, even though the entry's whole thesis is that Singed kills Teemo with a trade combo.
audit.why: Riot's text for Fling: "If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted." That is the sequence that actually ends a Teemo — goo on the ground behind him first, then Fling you backwards into it, and you are rooted inside a poison trail with no Move Quick answer. Without the goo down first, Fling is only a displacement you walk out of. The order is the counterplay, and neither layer states it.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive first, then Fling into it, equals a root. Fling with no goo on the ground is survivable — watch the ground, not his hands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The poison trail is called his passive in spikes[0] and whys[0]; his actual passive is credited with regeneration in early ("his passive regeneration").
audit.why: Poison Trail is Q, a toggle costing 13 mana per second. The passive is Noxious Slipstream, which grants a burst of move speed when Singed drafts past nearby champions — no regeneration of any kind. Getting this wrong matters practically: the trail is a mana drain he has to pay for continuously, which is a real pressure point, and Noxious Slipstream is the reason he catches a kiting Teemo at all.
audit.corrected: Poison Trail is Q and costs 13 mana per second; the passive is Noxious Slipstream, a move-speed burst from passing champions.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] says "Mega Adhesive grounds your W burst", and mid tells the player to blind Fling so "his auto-chain afterwards misses".
audit.why: Two separate errors. The kit describes grounding as shutting off dashes, and Move Quick carries no dash flag — it is a move-speed buff, so what beats it here is Mega Adhesive's slow, not its grounding. And Singed has no auto-chain to blind: Poison Trail is a toggle, Mega Adhesive is a thrown zone, Fling is a targeted ability. None of them are basic attacks, which whys[0] already states correctly. The mid paragraph contradicts the entry's own analysis.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive beats Move Quick with its slow. The blind does nothing to Singed's damage — none of it comes from basic attacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues, and the full layer says "track Fling" six times without a number.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13s. Mega Adhesive is the long one and it is the ability that makes Fling lethal, so the window worth counting is the goo, not the flip: after he throws Mega Adhesive you have roughly 17 seconds at rank 1 in which a Fling can only displace you, not root you.
audit.corrected: Count Mega Adhesive at 17s, not Fling at 10s — the goo is what turns a flip into a root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion is mentioned twice as a generic power-up ("Insanity Potion engage", "a clean Insanity Potion") with no description of what it does.

In a lane where Teemo often leans on Doran's Ring regen, Second Wind or omnivamp to stay in range, an ulted Singed switches that off for as long as you stand in the trail. It is also the only anti-heal in the matchup, and it belongs to him.
audit.corrected: Insanity Potion makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — your sustain stops working while you are in it.

audit.why: Singed has no healing in his kit — no slot in champ-data/_kits/singed.json carries a heal flag. He is in fact the one applying Grievous Wounds, through Insanity Potion. edits.before: Singed owns the first three levels in a way that feels unintuitive — he never auto-attacks you, never needs to. His poison trail punishes every minion-range step you take, and his passive regeneration plus Corrupted Fling's peel means he can walk into you, drop Mega Adhesive, and Fling you into the trail for a winning trade before your Blinding Shot matters. Do not auto him back. Sit at your absolute max auto range, poke only with AA-E-poison procs, and accept that levels 1-3 are about not falling behind on HP rather than winning lane. The moment you try to fight him like a normal melee matchup he chains your W escape with Adhesive and walks away winning the trade on poison alone.
edits.after: Singed owns the first three levels in a way that feels unintuitive — he never auto-attacks you, and never needs to. Poison Trail punishes every minion-range step you take, and Noxious Slipstream gives him a burst of speed just from drafting past you, so he closes without spending anything. Blinding Dart has no target here: nothing in his kit is a basic attack. Do not auto him back. Sit at your absolute max range, poke with Toxic Shot procs only, and accept that levels 1-3 are about not falling behind on HP rather than winning. The mistake that loses the lane is standing on Mega Adhesive — a Fling that lands you in the goo roots you, and a rooted Teemo in a poison trail is dead.

notes:
This entry contains outright fabrication rather than mislabelling: "Corrupted Fling" is not a League ability, and the text credits it with an AoE and with regeneration, neither of which exists in Singed's kit. "Toxic Trail" in the mid paragraph is a second invented name. Both should be treated as a signal to re-read the whole matchup rather than as isolated typos.

The Mega Adhesive to Fling root is the decisive mechanic in this lane and appeared nowhere in either layer. champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json does carry a teemo/singed row, but its only headline is "knockup-enabler: Both sides carry displacement (Noxious Trap (R) vs Fling (E)) — whoever lands it first owns the trade." That headline is FALSE on Teemo's side: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json flags Noxious Trap with "knockup" (a derived false positive from the word "bounce" in Riot's mushroom-onto-mushroom text). Mushrooms slow and damage; they never displace. The valid half of the interaction is Singed's Fling, and specifically Fling into his own goo.

full.breakdown.late prescribed early anti-heal against a champion with no healing in his kit — the same defect appears in this dataset's Riven entry, so the "anti-heal stays core" line is likely templated by carry threat rather than by kit contents. Worth a global check.

The grounding question was handled conservatively. The kit describes Mega Adhesive's grounding as shutting off dashes, and Move Quick carries no dash flag, so the corrected text attributes the counterplay to the slow instead. Whether grounding independently suppresses a pure move-speed buff is not settled by Riot's text and was deliberately not asserted in either direction.

full.focus ("Singed Fling", letters ["E"]) is a correct slot but arguably the wrong ability — Mega Adhesive is both the longer cooldown and the enabler. Left unedited; flagged.
